sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:66716
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2281 of 2024

Applicant :- Shashank Mishra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Saurabh Chaturvedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Meenendra Tripathi,Rakesh Kumar Gupta
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit and supplementary rejoinder affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri I.K. Chaturvedi, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Sri Saurabh Chaturvedi, learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Rakesh Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the informant and Dr. S.B.
Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.
3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
396 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 120-B, 307 IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Navabad, District Jhansi, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 12.12.2021 and since marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for dowry.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that on 8.10.2023 applicant opened fire upon the daughter of the informant i.e. injured and due to the fire opened by him she sustained injuries and she had been admitted in the hospital.

6. Learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegations applicant has been made accused in the present and applicant neither ever tortured the daughter of the informant nor he caused any fire arm injury to her.

7. He further submitted that actually it is a case of accidental firing and accidentally a shot was opened by the applicant upon her wife and when his wife sustained fire arm injury then he himself admitted her in the hospital which is about 60 km away from the house of the applicant and this fact is evident from the medical report of the victim.
8. He further submitted that the statement of the victim does not appear to be convincing.
He further submitted that from x-ray report of the victim it reflects that injuries sustained to her were not dangerous to life.

9. He further submitted that even within two days victim was discharged from the hospital and as on the basis of false allegations father of the victim lodged the FIR therefore, only due to this reason when the statements of the victim was recorded during investigation then she started making allegations agaisnt the applicant by reiterating the version of the FIR.
10.

He further submitted that applicant is a police personnel and he cannot think to cause injury to his wife and if he would have been caused injury to her then he would definitely not have taken her to the hospital.
11. He further submitted that applicant is under suspension and he is in jail in the present matter since 10.10.2023.

12. Per contra, learned AGA and learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is the husband of the victim and he was the police personnel and it was his duty to protect and maintain his wife but instead of doing so he tortured her badly for want of dowry and also caused fire arm injury to her.

13. They further submitted that from the perusal of the injury report of the injured it reflects that she sustained as many as six injuries and therefore, it cannot be said that it was a case of accidental firing.

14. They further argued, however, from the perusal of the medical report of the victim it reflects that applicant has taken her to the hospital but merely due to this fact, he cannot be said to be innocent and considering the fact that he is police personnel, he should not be released on bail.
15. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

sentences.text: 16. Applicant is husband of the injured and as per allegation since marriage applicant and his family members tortured her and on 8.10.2023 at about 11 pm in the night applicant caused fire arm injury to her.

17. From the perusal of the medical report of the victim, it reflects that she sustained as many as six injuries and according to the doctor injuries sustained by her were caused by fire arm, therefore,
prima facie, allegation levelled against the applicant appears to be ture.

18. However, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that it is a case of accidental firing but considering the injury report of the injured, it could not be reflected that it is a case of accidental firing.

19. Further, however, from the record it reflects that applicant after the incident admitted the injured in the hospital but this Court finds force in the argument advanced by learned AGA and learned counsel for the informant that merely on this ground it cannot be said that applicant is innocent considering the fact that he is the police personnel and he was not the layman and he was well aware about the legal procedure.
The possibility cannot be ruled out that merely to show his bonafide after the incident, he admitted his wife in the hospital.
Be that as it may this fact can only be properly appreciated by the trial court during trial.
21. Further, applicant is also a police officer and he was having greater responsibility on his shoulder.
Further, allegation made against him appears to be quite serious.
22. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail, at this stage.
23. Accordingly, the instant bail application stands rejected.

24. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Ankita  Shashank Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167077347/
